info.description: Loan-officer API in front of Apache Fineract. Amounts are ETB with 2 decimals. Log in with POST /api/auth/login, then click Authorize and paste the accessToken.
info.title: Adey MFI backend

post.summary: Log in with Fineract username + password; returns access and refresh tokens
Log out: revoke the refresh token (the access token expires on its own within 15 min)

get.summary: The officer the access token belongs to

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new token pair (the old refresh token stops working)

parameters.description: Part of the client's name. Case-sensitive (Fineract on PostgreSQL).
parameters.name: search

get.summary: Search clients (paged): an officer sees their own clients, a manager their whole office

parameters.description: Optional. A unique id (e.g. a UUID) the app creates once per action and sends again on every retry. A retry with the same key and body returns the first response instead of running twice. Valid for 24 hours.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.summary: Create a client in your office (officer: assigned to you; manager: choose staffId)

get.summary: Client details (403 if the client is not yours / not in your office)

put.summary: Edit a client's basic details (only the fields you send are changed)

get.summary: A client's loans with progress and next due installment
List loan products with their principal / repayment ranges

parameters.description: true = only loans with an installment past due, false = only loans without
parameters.name: inArrears

get.summary: Loans you may see, filtered. status=PENDING is the approval queue (oldest first); inArrears=true is the collection list (most days overdue first)

parameters.description: Optional. A unique id (e.g. a UUID) the app creates once per action and sends again on every retry. A retry with the same key and body returns the first response instead of running twice. Valid for 24 hours.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.summary: Submit a loan application (409 if the client already has a loan in progress)
Preview a repayment schedule without creating a loan

get.summary: Loan details: totals, full schedule and transactions

post.summary: Approve a submitted application (branch manager only)
Disburse (pay out) an approved loan; it becomes Active (branch manager only)
Reject a submitted application (branch manager only)

parameters.description: Optional. A unique id (e.g. a UUID) the app creates once per action and sends again on every retry. A retry with the same key and body returns the first response instead of running twice. Valid for 24 hours.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

post.summary: Record a repayment; returns how it was split over principal/interest/fees/penalties
Undo an approval: back to pending, only before disbursement (branch manager only)

get.summary: Dashboard: counts, outstanding, PAR1/PAR30, due today, overdue (+ per officer for managers)
Payment types an officer can choose for disbursements and repayments

approvedAmount.description: Approve less than requested. Defaults to the requested principal.

activate.description: Activate immediately (default true). Inactive clients cannot get loans.

dateOfBirth.description: ISO date. The client must be at least 18 years old.

externalId.description: National ID number (stored as Fineract externalId). Optional, must be unique.

mobileNo.description: Ethiopian mobile number, 10 digits starting 09 or 07

staffId.description: Managers only: the loan officer (staff id) of your office to assign. Officers leave it empty; the client is assigned to them.

paymentTypeId.description: How the money was handed over (see GET /api/payment-types).
